newsitem.title: POLAND: Exbud to replace Kety in WIG20.
newsitem.headline: Exbud to replace Kety in WIG20.

text.p: Construction firm Exbud SA will replace aluminium plant Kety SA in the Warsaw bourse's blue-chip WIG20 index from April 16, a bourse official said on Wednesday.

Beata Mroz from the exchange's statistics and research department told Reuters that the stock would be automatically added to the remaining 21 issues now traded in both the single-price auction system and continuous trading system.

The index, which is made up of the exchange's 20 highest capitalised and most actively traded companies, is revised quarterly to account for changes in the stocks' turnovers and market capitalisation.

Mroz said the bourse was currently mulling whether to introduce new criteria for stocks to be listed in continuous trade, such as liquidity at regular trade's post-price-fixing order-balancing session, and number of live-trade transactions.

"It sometimes happens that there are no transactions completed (in continuous trade) so maybe firms will not be listed in the continuous system if there's a minimum number of transactions," Mroz said.
